stalls.summaryZh: 中華街代表性的老字號，肉燥香而不膩，是多篇懶人包首推。
stalls.summaryEn: The street's signature old-timer; fragrant, not-too-greasy pork rice topping several round-ups.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 配料可挑多樣、份量大方，黑糖碗粿也有人推。
stalls.summaryEn: Pick-your-toppings ice in generous portions; the brown-sugar wa-gui also gets praise.

sources.title: 輕旅行：鳳山中華夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 以湯品甜點為主的老店，夏天來碗綠豆湯消暑。
stalls.summaryEn: Long-standing sweet-soup shop; mung bean soup is the summer pick.

sources.title: 輕旅行：鳳山中華夜市美食

foodsEn: Pork knuckle rice with bamboo shoots
stalls.summaryZh: 腿庫滷得軟爛不油，搭筍乾很下飯，老闆待客熱情。
stalls.summaryEn: Soft, non-greasy braised knuckle with bamboo shoots and a friendly owner.

sources.title: 輕旅行：鳳山中華夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 湯頭清甜的魚湯，適合配肉燥飯一起吃。
stalls.summaryEn: Clean, sweet fish soup that pairs well with pork rice.
